summary.bn: মোবাইল নেটওয়ার্কে SMS পাঠায় আর পায়; বোর্ড AT কমান্ড দিয়ে কথা বলে। ল্যাবের নেটওয়ার্ক বানানো: কোনো আসল SMS যায় না।
summary.en: Sends and receives SMS on a mobile network; the board talks to it with AT commands. The lab's network is made up: no real SMS is sent.

simplified: The network is the lab's own: no SIM card, no real messages, no calls or data. SMS go to and come from the lab's phone panel, whose number is not a real one.

It answers a set of AT commands in text mode: AT, ATE, ATI, CSQ, CREG, CPIN, COPS, CMGF, CSCS, CNMI, CMGS, CMGR, CMGD, CMGDA. Anything else gets ERROR. It learns the baud rate from the first "AT", as the real module does.
It finds the network about 3 seconds after power-up and takes about 3 seconds to send an SMS: estimates. Text is in the GSM alphabet: letters other than plain Latin (Bangla, for one) arrive as "?".

It needs 3.4 V to 4.4 V, as SIMCom gives; more is shown as damage. Its peaks of up to 2 A while transmitting are not modelled, so a weak supply that makes a real module restart does not here. Its TX line is a 2.8 V signal.
